title: 2.7.5 Updates
message:
• Now, you can receive in-app updates! Like this.
• Added **Send Feedback** button in Settings.
• Join our [Reddit community](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/)!
• Now your deleted notes are safe for some time in the Recycle Bin.

title: 2.7.4 Performance & Rendering Boost
message:
• Smoother canvas scrolling on high refresh rate displays (90Hz / 120Hz).
• Reduced memory footprint when rendering extensive sticky walls.

title: 2.7.3 Canvas Pinch & Zoom Refinements
message:
• Added smoother gesture response when zooming out on large walls.
• Fine-tuned snap-to-grid thresholds for precise alignment.

title: 2.7.2 Widget Refresh & Sync Improvements
message:
• Widgets now refresh immediately after editing text or drawing on the canvas.
• Fixed a rare visual glitch when updating widget snapshots in background.

title: 2.7.1 Drawing Mode Smooth Ink Engine
message:
• Ink strokes now render with pressure sensitivity and anti-aliased curves.
• Added quick eraser undo for pencil and marker tools.

title: 2.7.0 Folders Drag and Drop Experience
message:
• Drag any note onto another to automatically create and organize notes in folders.
• Seamless folder expansion and single-tap dilution.

title: 2.6.9 Recycle Bin Safe Storage
message:
• Introducing the Recycle Bin! Deleted sticky notes can now be restored.
• Permanently delete or restore notes anytime with a single tap.

title: 2.6.8 Typography & Special Elite Tuning
message:
• Improved typewriter font alignment across different Android screen densities.
• Better character spacing for handwriting and cursive styles.

title: 2.6.7 Washi Tape Styling Options
message:
• Added classic and colorful washi tape strips for your notes.
• Toggle washi tape on or off anytime in Settings.

title: 2.6.6 Wall Theme Contrast Enhancements
message:
• Refined dark cork and pastel wall backgrounds for higher text legibility.
• Subtle ambient shadows for realistic paper depth.

title: 2.6.5 Recycle Bin Initial Preview
message:
• Safe temporary retention for deleted sticky notes.
• Preview note content before restoring to canvas.

title: 2.6.4 Quick Note Creation Shortcuts
message:
• Double-tap on any empty canvas area to instantly spawn a sticky note.
• Default sticky note colors can now match your last picked palette.

title: 2.6.3 Color Palette Vibrancy Polish
message:
• Added warm honey, sage green, and lavender pastel tints to the palette picker.
• Contrast adjusted for both daylight and nighttime reading.

title: 2.6.2 Widget Pool Memory Optimization
message:
• Background widget pool now stores optimized snapshot caches.
• Lower battery consumption when using multiple home screen widgets.

title: 2.6.1 Checklist Reordering Smoothness
message:
• Drag to reorder checklist items with tactile haptic feedback.
• Strikethrough completed items with satisfying animations.

title: 2.6.0 Multi-Language Localization Expansion
message:
• Digital Sticky Notes is now available in 14 languages worldwide!
• Switch languages instantly from Settings > Globe icon.

title: 2.5.9 Backup & Restore Stability
message:
• Export all your notes into an encrypted .json file for safe offline keeping.
• One-tap import restores walls, colors, folders, and positions.

title: 2.5.8 Clean Wall View Mode
message:
• Hide all interface buttons for an immersive full-screen display of your wall.
• Tap anywhere to reveal navigation controls again.

title: 2.5.7 Haptic Feedback Tuning
message:
• Subtle tactile feedback when moving notes, toggling switches, and pinning.
• Can be adjusted according to system haptics preferences.

title: 2.5.6 Search & Filter Enhancements
message:
• Faster note lookup by title, content, or color tag.
• Filter active sticky notes across folders and stacks.

title: 2.5.5 High-Resolution Image Export
message:
• Export any sticky note or full wall snapshot in crystal clear PNG quality.
• Share directly to messaging apps, social media, or cloud storage.

title: 2.5.4 Tablet & Foldable Screen Support
message:
• Optimized responsive layouts for large Android tablets and foldables.
• Expanded canvas workspace with adaptive side margins.

title: 2.5.3 Dark Mode Canvas Comfort
message:
• Inverted dark wall themes for late night journaling and studying.
• Automatic theme switching based on Android system appearance.

title: 2.5.2 Drawing Palette Brush Sizes
message:
• Added fine, medium, and broad stroke widths for hand-drawn sketches.
• Color swatches now sync with active note paper colors.

title: 2.5.1 Quick Note Duplication
message:
• Long press a sticky note to quickly clone it with identical styling.
• Useful for repetitive task templates and weekly planning.

title: 2.5.0 Wall Organization Stacks
message:
• Stack related notes neatly on top of each other to save canvas space.
• Peel through stacked notes with intuitive touch gestures.

title: 2.4.9 Android 14 System Compatibility
message:
• Full compatibility updates for modern Android 14 / API 34 standards.
• Predictive back gesture animations and enhanced permission security.

title: 2.4.8 Lock Sticky Note Position
message:
• Pin critical notes in place so they cannot be accidentally moved or dragged.
• Tap lock icon in note options to freeze position.

title: 2.4.7 Checklist Progress Counters
message:
• Visual progress indicator shows completed items (e.g., 3/5 done) on cards.
• Motivational celebration animation upon checking off all items.

title: 2.4.6 Minimalist Widget Layout
message:
• Streamlined borderless widget options for clean Android home screens.
• Supports transparent background mode.

title: 2.4.5 Auto-Save & Crash Protection
message:
• Real-time auto-saving keeps every keystroke safe even if the app closes.
• Zero risk of losing drafts or quick ideas.

title: 2.4.4 Custom Font Sizing Controls
message:
• Adjust note text size from compact to extra-large for optimal readability.
• Independent font settings for titles and body text.

title: 2.4.3 Reddit Community Milestones
message:
• Join over thousands of sticky note fans sharing wallpapers and setups!
• Share your aesthetic walls on r/DigitalStickyNotesApp.

title: 2.4.2 Quick Date Stamp Insertion
message:
• Single tap inserts today's date and time stamp into any active note draft.
• Perfect for meeting minutes, logs, and daily journals.

title: 2.4.1 Canvas Grid Snapping
message:
• Optional magnetic grid lines help keep rows and columns neatly organized.
• Easily toggle snap-to-grid on and off.

title: 2.4.0 Interactive User Guide Release
message:
• Step-by-step interactive visual guide accessible anytime from Settings.
• Learn advanced features like gestures, stacking, and widget setup.

title: 2.3.9 Battery Saver Mode
message:
• Optimized render loops reduce background battery consumption to near zero.
• Smooth 60fps animations with minimal processor usage.

title: 2.3.8 Recycle Bin Permanence
message:
• Improved local storage caching for notes kept in the Recycle Bin.
• View note creation dates and timestamps easily.

title: 2.3.7 Color Picker Spectrum
message:
• Expanded pastel, neon, and earth-toned sticky note color options.
• Save your favorite custom color combinations.

title: 2.3.6 Quick Clear Wall Action
message:
• Archive all canvas notes to the Recycle Bin in a single protected action.
• Start fresh with a blank canvas anytime.

title: 2.3.5 Offline-First Architecture
message:
• Digital Sticky Notes is 100% private and offline-first.
• All your notes, drawings, and widgets stay strictly on your local device.

title: 2.3.4 Special Elite Character Support
message:
• Extended glyph support for accented characters and international symbols.
• Clean typography across Latin, Cyrillic, and extended character sets.

title: 2.3.3 Widget Tap Actions
message:
• Tap home screen widget to jump straight into editing that specific note.
• Seamless transition from home screen to canvas.

title: 2.3.2 Note Sharing Text Format
message:
• Share note content as plain text or formatted markdown with one tap.
• Convenient for pasting into emails, chats, or document apps.

title: 2.3.1 Smooth Gesture Physics
message:
• Realistic physics-based inertia when tossing or sliding notes across canvas.
• Natural friction deceleration feel.

title: 2.3.0 Checklist Multi-Select
message:
• Bulk select checklist items to delete or re-tag multiple tasks together.
• Clean batch workflow for to-do lists.

title: 2.2.9 Storage Usage Summary
message:
• Settings now displays local storage space used by notes and cached snapshots.
• Manage storage footprint easily.

title: 2.2.8 Welcome & Newcomer Tips
message:
• Practical onboarding cards for first-time app explorers.
• Helpful tips on backups, widgets, and wall aesthetics.

title: 2.2.7 Community Wall Showcase
message:
• Check out creative study walls and mood boards created by fellow users.
• Submit your own setups to be featured in the community!

title: 2.2.0 Digital Sticky Notes 2.0 Genesis
message:
• Welcome to the all-new Digital Sticky Notes experience!
• Infinite canvas, home screen widgets, hand drawing, and tactile sticky paper.
